notes.title: The Kickstarter is %40 Funded!! Get The Game 33% Off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298140/f99fbc1797a2c625dcc6976aaf1513fe93d0a5ee.gif[/img]
[h1][b]Thank you!! So damn much![/b][/h1] 

I can't tell you how encouraging it is to hear a resounding "I want to decapitate my friends, but not before I give them a kiss." Because of you, we're 40% of the way funded, and the announcement video is sitting at 255k views! It's been very difficult to show my game to all the normal people in my life, so it's a relief that there are people like us who DO think it's cool. And DON'T give me a weird look when I try to tell them about it.

[h1]Where we are now:[/h1]

I'm hard at work to continue promoting the game in all places (bsky, twitter, on the kickstarter, contacting press, publishers). At this point, it would be a huge help if you could tell any of your friends and estranged family about the game. I'm available throughout the day on my discord if you ever have any questions, just want to say hi, or want to connect about a possible way to expand our audience. If you have any connections in games journalism, V-tubers, no matter how big or small they are, I am more than happy to chat with them about the game. 

[u]Thank you for your time and support, and making one freak's passion possible for everyone to enjoy.
[/u][b]
All relevant info and links at https://mamasleepingangels.com/ for steam policy reasons.[/b]

-itamu
